_source: Official rulebook v1.0 §2.3 (book p.13-14); verified against page scans
_notes: Each die face is a list of icons; a double-icon face (e.g. Light Hit x2) is two separately-offsettable icons.
hollow icons have no effect by default; certain Stances upgrade them to solid (OFF: attack dice hollows, DEF: white-die hollows).
lightning/eye have no effect in generic attack/defense resolution; specific Actions may consume them.
Reroll rule: each player may reroll dice once per roll event (standing/off-table dice are re-rolled free).
packQuantities is photo-derived from the product image (p.13) and unverified.

red.role: Attack rolls - Heavy Hits (powerful, slower attacks)

yellow.role: Attack rolls and Electronic Counter-rolls - Light Hits (fast, sustained attacks)

white.role: Defense and Parry rolls - Defense icons (offset Light Hits only)

blue.role: Mobility rolls - Dodge icons (offset any damage icon)

offsetRules.dodge: 1 Dodge icon offsets any 1 icon (Light Hit or Heavy Hit); a Dodge-offset icon does NOT count as a Hit (no on-hit riders).
offsetRules.defense: 1 Defense icon offsets only 1 Light Hit; a Defense-offset icon still counts as a Hit (on-hit riders trigger).
offsetRules.penetration: Any un-offset damage icon causes Penetration (part state Intact -> Damaged -> Destroyed).
